purpose: NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX rack-scale interactive inference accelerator platform.

hardware.architecture: Groq 3 Language Processing Unit integrated as an LPX rack extension for NVIDIA Vera Rubin
hardware.availability_note: NVIDIA announced full production on 2026-08-24. Nebius is the first announced adopter; Groq and Dell are also working to deploy LPX with Vera Rubin NVL72.

performance_evidence.manufacturer_comparison_claim: 4x faster than the nearest alternative platform
performance_evidence.normalization_note: Treat the 4x statement as NVIDIA's summary of the independent benchmark; use the underlying Artificial Analysis methodology for cross-platform normalization.

research_notes: LPX is optimized for low-latency token generation and is intended to complement, not replace, Vera Rubin GPU compute.
The per-LPU memory hierarchy is unusual: only 500 MB of very-high-bandwidth SRAM per LPU, while the rack provides 12 TB of DDR5 for model/workload capacity.
Do not compare the 150 TB/s per-LPU SRAM bandwidth directly with HBM capacity/bandwidth metrics without accounting for the different memory hierarchy and workload placement.
No stable standalone hardware price or power figure was captured in the current manufacturer sources.
